propositions: BindingRepository must own live, retired, rotation, and alert files with byte-identical round-trip serialization and no eager writes on construction.

Unconditional save persists in order: rotation tempfile/write/replace first, then retired tempfile/write/replace, then live tempfile/write/replace, with inline last_get_pass floor retained across rotation failures.
Rotation persistence failure leaves sidecar old and live new without raising; next save recovers by writing the retained inline floor to sidecar before live replacement.
Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts deduped alert with swallowed alert failures.
Live and retired tempfile/write/replace failures raise after cleanup and after persisting any prior rotation/retired writes; rotation failure is swallowed.
